title: RawEvent
description: Spec-ahead (ADR 0005; client writes start in its transition phase). Unordered, idempotent inbox entry: raw input from a source or a user command, before the foodsavr_core pipeline. Firestore: owners/{ownerId}/rawEvents/{id}. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

id.description: Idempotency key and document ID: source:provider:externalId

ownerId.description: User or group the event belongs to

source.description: Input class; extends LineItem IngestionSource with order and userCommand

provider.description: e.g. rema, coop, trumf, pizzabakeren; null for app-local input (written as app in the id)

externalId.description: Source-assigned ID (transaction ID, receipt hash, client UUID generated once per user action for commands)

occurredAt.description: When it happened at the source

receivedAt.description: Server timestamp on write; the client sets it with the server-timestamp sentinel

payload.description: Source-specific raw data, opaque to everything but its adapter

processedSeq.description: seq of the domain event produced from it; set by the worker, always null on client create

userCommandPayload.description: First user command types (transition phase): the user ate or threw away part of a product

type.description: Becomes the domain event of the same type

productId.description: products document the command applied to

expirationDate.description: Expiry entry the units came from; null for the non-expiring pool

productName.description: Snapshot so history survives deleting the product
